name: Animated Shield

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Animate
powers.text: Bonus Action: the shield floats and protects you for 1 minute with your hands free (once per dawn).

summary: A Bonus Action animates it for 1 minute: it guards you as if wielded, leaving your hands free.
text: While holding this Shield, you can take a Bonus Action to cause it to animate. The Shield leaps into the air and hovers in your space to protect you as if you were wielding it, leaving your hands free. The Shield remains animated for 1 minute, until you take a Bonus Action to end this effect, or until you die or have the Incapacitated condition, at which point the Shield falls or returns to your hand if you have one free. Once the Shield is animated, it can't be animated again until the next dawn.
